headline: VERDICT: FABRICATED EXTRACTION - DO NOT CITE THIS POOLED ESTIMATE
body: Source verification on 2026-07-30 (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 + PubMed, every identifier by lookup) found that NEITHER fitted trial's 2x2 table exists in its cited source. The previously displayed pooled OR 0.389 (95% CI 0.134-1.124) has no evidentiary basis and has been withdrawn.

NCT00814671 - QUARANTINED: wrong population and fabricated cells. This is a Phase 2 ACTIVE smear-positive pulmonary TB TREATMENT trial (Cape Town, n=153), not a latent-TB trial. Its extracted events 46 and 45 are not events at all: they are the ANALYSIS-SET DENOMINATORS of two arms in a secondary median-days outcome (time to conversion on liquid MGIT media), paired with participant-flow randomisation counts from two DIFFERENT arms (54 and 48) as denominators. The trial's actual primary outcome is 85% of 41, 94% of 36, 96% of 45 with negative culture at week 8 - and it randomised three arms, of which the app fits two.

NCT01582711 (iAdhere, TBTC Study 33) - QUARANTINED: wrong outcome. Denominators 337/337 are correct, but the numerators 2 and 5 are the category 'Not advisable to continue study drugs' - one of EIGHT reasons-for-failure-to-complete, a clinician-judgement administrative reason. The trial's primary outcome is treatment completion: 294/337 (87.2%) directly observed vs 248/335 (74.0%) self-administered (Belknap R et al, Ann Intern Med 2017;167:689-697, PMID 29114781). iAdhere is a NON-INFERIORITY trial with a 15% margin; that frame was discarded.

SIGN CONFLICT: the withdrawn pooled estimate combined a GOOD outcome (negative culture, where OR<1 means WORSE) with a BAD outcome (failure-to-complete reason, where OR<1 means BETTER) on one odds-ratio scale with no sign reconciliation. The app's own machine verdict had already recorded '2 AACT outcome-direction divergence(s)' while this badge displayed a green INTERNAL CHECKS PASSED.

EVIDENCE BASE ABSENT: the landmark rifapentine-LTBI efficacy trial, PREVENT TB / TBTC Study 26 (NCT00023452; Sterling TR et al, N Engl J Med 2011;365:2155-66, PMID 22150035 - TB in 7 of 3986 with 3HP vs 15 of 3745 with 9H) does not appear anywhere in this app.

GATES RUN, AND WHAT THEY COULD NOT SEE: per-arm count plausibility 0 findings and contrast recompute exact to 0.00e+00 - the arithmetic layer is clean because fabricated cells can still be valid integers. GRIM/GRIMMER N/A (binary outcome, no means). Benford N/A (8 digits total, far below a meaningful chi-square). Fragility index N/A (neither contrast is significant: Fisher p=0.2098 and p=0.4507 - and FI on a fabricated 2x2 measures nothing). Identifiers: ZERO PMIDs and ZERO DOIs anywhere in this app. Registry concordance was the only gate that could catch this, and it failed 2 of 2.

ALSO FLAGGED: this app embeds a heart-failure trial alias table (PARADIGM-HF, PARAGON-HF, PARADISE-MI, PARAGLIDE-HF) inherited from the base engine; scripts/clone_contamination_gate.py blocks on it. The SGLT2i adverse-event profile is clean here.
AMSTAR-2 confidence: CRITICALLY LOW. Both trial rows are RETAINED in the ledger and flagged, not deleted. No count was altered - there is no sourced value to correct them to.
footer: Full per-cell provenance, quoted registry fields and the reinstatement conditions: outputs/rifapentine_tb_source_verification.json and outputs/RIFAPENTINE_TB_INTEGRITY_GATES_2026-07-30.md. Verified 2026-07-30 against ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (live) and PubMed. STAGED, not pushed; pending cross-family gate.

reasons: NCT00814671: wrong population (active pulmonary TB treatment trial in a latent-TB review)
NCT00814671: all four 2x2 cells fabricated - secondary-outcome analysis-set denominators used as event counts, paired with participant-flow counts from different arms
NCT00814671: 3 randomised arms collapsed to 2; RPT600 (best-performing) silently dropped
NCT01582711: wrong outcome - 'Not advisable to continue study drugs' (1 of 8 failure-reason classes) extracted instead of the primary treatment-completion outcome 294/337 vs 248/335
NCT01582711: non-inferiority design (15% margin) pooled into a superiority odds ratio
NCT01582711: 3 randomised arms collapsed to 2; SAT+SMS arm silently dropped
Sign conflict: a beneficial outcome and a harmful outcome pooled on one OR scale without reconciliation
Zero PMIDs and zero DOIs anywhere in the app
DerSimonian-Laird pooling at k=2 (biased for k<10; REML or Paule-Mandel required)
PREVENT TB (NCT00023452, PMID 22150035), the landmark efficacy trial for this question, is absent
Blocking clone contamination: heart-failure trial alias table (PARADIGM-HF/PARAGON-HF/PARADISE-MI/PARAGLIDE-HF)

lanes_not_run: WHO prequalification / TB preventive-treatment guideline tables
